resources.string: Tap a topic to see how
Add games, play, adjust Graphics and on-screen keys
Copy the game folder to your phone, tap + and the app finds it

string-array.name: agvn_guide_add_steps
string-array.item: Copy the whole game folder (unzipped, with its .exe) from your computer to your phone, for example: Internal storage/AGVN/Game name. Don\'t copy .zip files or installers (setup).
Keep games in the AGVN or Download folder (in internal storage or on the SD card). Don\'t put them in Documents: the app doesn\'t look there.

Tap the + button in the library (or \"Add game\" in Settings). The app finds games and lists them: \"Not added\" games on top, games already in the library below (with a check mark). Type a few letters in \"Search games\" to filter quickly, no accents needed.
Tap the game\'s name, then tap \"Import\" (for a game already added, the button says \"Update\"). The app picks on-screen keys and Graphics that suit the game and your phone.
Game somewhere else? Tap \"Pick another folder\", open the folder with the game, then tap \"Scan this folder\". The app remembers that folder for next time.
If the app says it can\'t read storage: tap \"Grant access\", then turn on Allow access to manage all files (Android 11 and up) or go to Permissions → Storage → Allow (Android 9, 10).

resources.string: Tap ▶ to play, the Back button opens the menu

string-array.name: agvn_guide_play_steps
string-array.item: In the library, tap ▶ on the game\'s cover (or tap the cover, then \"Play\"). The first start takes a little longer.
In game, press the phone\'s Back button (or tap with 4 fingers at once) to open the menu on the left.
To exit a game: save first, open the menu, then tap the red power button at the bottom. The game closes right away, without asking.
The pause button in the menu freezes the game. To keep playing: press the phone\'s Back button to open the menu again (while paused, a 4-finger tap doesn\'t open it), then tap the play button.

resources.string: Drag the slider: left is cooler, right is prettier

string-array.name: agvn_guide_graphics_steps
string-array.item: In the library, tap ⋮ on the game, then pick \"Adjust Graphics: cooler ↔ prettier\".
Drag the slider left (Ultra light, Low) for a cooler, smoother phone. Drag it right (High, Very high) for a nicer picture but a hotter phone.
The level with ★ is the one the app suggests for your phone. Tap \"Back to suggested\" to let the app choose.
Very high has no FPS limit, so it doesn\'t override the FPS settings of the game and cheat menus. If the phone gets too hot, open the in-game menu, Video section, and set \"FPS limit\" to 60.
Tap \"Save\", then exit the game and open it again to apply.

resources.string: Add, move and change keys right in game

string-array.name: agvn_guide_controls_steps
string-array.item: In game there is a small bar at the top center: \"✎ Edit\" to change keys, \"👁 Hide\" to hide or show the keys, \"⌨\" to open the keyboard. The bar hides after 3 seconds so it doesn\'t cover the game, leaving a faint line at the top edge: tap that line to show it again.

Tap \"✎ Edit\": drag a button to move it. Tap a button to select it, then use \"Keys…\" to change its key, \"－\" / \"＋\" to shrink or enlarge it, \"Style…\" to change its shape (circle, square, rectangle, rounded) and opacity, \"Delete\" to remove it.
\"+ Button\" shows the full keyboard and mouse: tap the key you want. \"+ Look area\" adds a swipe area to turn the camera in 3D games.
Tick \"Hold\" when picking a key if you want the button to hold on one tap and release on the next (for example, holding the mouse to drag and drop).
Tap \"Done\" to save. Keys are saved separately for each game.

resources.string: Tap to click, touch, hold and drag to drag and drop

string-array.name: agvn_guide_mouse_steps
string-array.item: 1-finger tap = left click right where you tap.
Right click: first tap 1 finger where you want to click, then tap 2 fingers at once = right click at that spot.
Touch, hold and drag = hold the left mouse button and drag (drag items, draw a selection box…).
Swipe up or down with 2 fingers to scroll.

resources.string: Lower Graphics, close other apps, send error logs

string-array.name: agvn_guide_trouble_steps
string-array.item: Lower Graphics to \"Ultra light\" (⋮ on the game, \"Adjust Graphics\"), then open the game again.
Close other running apps so the game has enough RAM.
Check that the game folder was fully copied, with no missing files.
Still broken: go to Settings, tap \"Export error logs\". The log file is in the Download folder; send it to AGVN for help.

resources.string: Get more Wine versions and drivers, fine-tune settings

string-array.name: agvn_guide_expert_steps
string-array.item: The app comes with everything needed to play: you don\'t need to download anything else.
If you know Wine/drivers: go to Settings, open \"Advanced (for experts)\" to get more Wine, Proton, DXVK and graphics drivers, and to manage environments.
To fine-tune one game: tap ⋮ on the game, then pick \"Configure\".
